'''Roval''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He participated in the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]].

==Biography==
Roval served in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]. A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], the Imperial was stationed on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Politics/Legends|Empire's]] [[Battle of Corellia|invasion]] of the world.<ref name="The Fight for Axial Park" />

On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], caught in a fierce battle between the forces of the Empire and that of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the lieutenant's unit was tasked to advance towards the Republic's [[Sith War Memorial Garden]] at [[Axial Park]].<ref name="The Fight for Axial Park" />

The Imperials captured [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] buildings as they fought through Republic [[Trooper/Legends|troops]], yet as the task force approached the Memorial Garden from a structure nearby, they became entrenched there before they could reach the Garden, though they were the closest of all Imperial forces to it.<ref name="The Fight for Axial Park" />

Caught in a web of Republic snipers nested between Axial Park and the Sith War Memorial, all attempts to further advance and conduct a final push into the War Memorial were of no use, and only eight Imperial Guard Commanders, three Sith, and four Imperial medics remained around the area, which was additionally surrounded by Republic heavy troopers led by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], these forces attacking the Imperials guarding the building's entrance whilst Republic master snipers and their subordinates set their scopes on the outpost's flanking walls.<ref name="The Fight for Axial Park" />

Amidst the firefight, an Imperial hero sent by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Hesker]] reached their outpost. This individual was allowed through the Imperial unit's defensive perimeter made before the outpost's entrance and found Roval taking shelter behind a desk deep within the building.<ref name="The Fight for Axial Park" />

Meeting with the new-arrival, Lieutenant Roval contacted Hesker, allowing the general to brief the Imperial hero on the final assault in the fight for Axial Park. The Empire-aligned individual then proceeded to sack the Republic's memorial gardens.<ref name="Sacking the Gardens">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Sacking the Gardens|Corellia}}</ref>

==Equipment==
Roval was [[Clothing/Legends|clothed]] in Imperial uniform and wore a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] over his shoulders.<ref name="The Fight for Axial Park" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Contact Lieutenant Roval in our outpost. We'll coordinate your final assault from there.|General Hesker|<ref name="The Fight for Axial Park" /><ref name="Sacking the Gardens" />}}
Roval appears in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]]. During the Imperial-faction planetary storyline for Corellia, a dialogue segment with Lieutenant Roval ends and initiates the quests "The Fight for Axial Park" and "Sacking the Gardens" respectively.<ref name="The Fight for Axial Park" /><ref name="Sacking the Gardens" />
